_comment: Copy this file to the SERVER'S DATA DIRECTORY as version.json to enable update notices. The server re-reads it on every /version request, so edits take effect immediately - no restart. 'latest' must be major.minor.patch; 'url' is where the Get-it button sends people (your GitHub Releases page); 'notes' is an optional one-liner shown in the banner.
notes: Move a planned block to any day, or swap two, by dragging - with an Undo button. A red line marks the time now, and the mouse wheel no longer changes a setting you only hover. On the phone: hold a block to drag it, double-tap for its menu. IMPORTANT - update, then delete any older TickTimer you still have installed: an old build can silently strip a newer planner.
